rationale: Sub-classifier A halts because blast_radius >= 4 (all in-flight and future webhook deliveries on the production worker are immediately affected) and severity >= 4 (immediate, silent validation failures for external webhook senders with no replay buffer); Sub-classifier B fires on all three markers because the secret is permanently overwritten in Cloudflare's secrets store, external webhook senders are impacted outside the system boundary, and there is no documented rollback or undo procedure to restore the old secret value.
